name: Sella Varre, Market-Warden of Firstsight
role: Chief of the Baron's market wardens at Firstsight: collects ten shards at the market gate and sends the Baron four
knowledge: Exactly how much the Baron thinks the market makes, and how much it does
Which of her wardens would testify, and which would run
The Baron's temper, to the day
wants: To leave Firstsight rich before the Baron counts
appearance: A tall woman in the Barony's grey with a warden's staff and very good boots, standing at the market gate with her hand out and her eyes on the road.
voiceHints: Clipped and official, every sentence a regulation, until she lowers her voice to name the other price.
_why: SNG-663 §2e.4 (CCODE-558): the Barony's corrupt wardens, as the one person exposing them makes an enemy of. Cruel Baron, so exposing her is dangerous for her too.
questSeeds: A merchant turned away at Firstsight's market gate says Sella Varre named him a price twice the Baron's posted one, and he means to tell the Baron, which will get him killed unless someone gets there with proof first.
